description: Landlord possession court action statistics from HM Courts & Tribunals Service (MoJ), updated quarterly.

datasets.description: Total number of landlord possession claims issued in the county courts

datasets.name: Landlord Repossessions by Bailiffs
datasets.description: Number of properties repossessed by county court bailiffs following a landlord possession order

datasets.description: Landlord possession claims issued specifically by private sector landlords (accelerated and standard)

datasets.name: Accelerated Possession Claims Issued

datasets.name: Median Time for Landlord Possession — Claim to Repossession
